verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you click the headphones icon in a conversation header to start a huddle. They also say huddles happen right in Slack, letting users instantly connect over audio or video and share screens, so the call starts without leaving the app. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that huddles can be started from DMs (docs say 'conversation header' rather than naming channels and DMs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
